title: NEW MSFS 2024 Marketplace Activity Packs! | Perfect Flight Review & Flight Styles
description:
The weekly Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace update is here, and this time we are diving deep into three major new activity expansions from Perfect Flight built to take your pilot career to the next level in MSFS 2024.

Early community feedback is locked in at a flawless five stars across the board, but keep in mind those early reviews might be discussable. Whether you want to conquer long-haul commercial itineraries, test your stick and rudder handling on technical runways, or go low and slow over majestic mountain peaks, this update delivers. To help you choose your next big aviation project, we are breaking these releases down into three logical flight style buckets:

First up, we are tackling the Commercial Jet Itinerary with the "Ryanair Spring 2026 12 Legs" pack. You get 12 ultra-realistic IFR missions mirroring real-world routing alongside an official Ryanair livery and cabin interior for the default Boeing 737 MAX. Your cockpit skills will be tested with professional flight briefings covering routes, airspace, and destinations, monitored by over 100 discrete in-flight events. It even includes a dedicated custom mini-browser in the game to view PDF airport charts, SIDs, STARs, and approach plates on the fly.

If you’d rather trade standard airline routes for raw skill building, group two features the "High-Intensity Skill Builders." This package challenges your precision landing skills across 16 grueling challenges. You will pilot six different aircraft classes—ranging from nimble Cessnas up to heavy metal like the Boeing F/A-18E Super Hornet—visiting a long list of technical airfields worldwide.

Finally, group three takes us on an Epic Wilderness VFR Tour through Patagonia. Flying along the Chile-Argentina border in the Diamond DA62, you will navigate 12 handcrafted, point-by-point visual missions. This stunning tour showcases glacial lake districts, temperate rainforests, open steppes, fjords, and the dramatic granite towers of the region, forcing you to master your visual altitude management.

In this video, we break down exactly what you get inside these mission browsers, check out the specific aircraft classes, and analyze whether these packs are truly worth your hard-earned marketplace credits.

✈️ What do you think? Are you planning to pick up these official activity packs from the Marketplace, or will you stick to planning your own routes? Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below!

Don't forget to like, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
